name: loom-pane
description: A pane of the repo's worktrees for loom sessions, plus guards that keep an owner inside its own worktree and ask before a removal loses work.

guards.title: Guards
guards.description: Deny an owner's edits outside its own worktree and ask before a branch force-delete or worktree removal that would lose work.

pollMs.title: Poll interval (ms)
pollMs.description: How often the open pane re-reads git, in milliseconds.
